description:
Zorvu's estimate of how much of an official Robinhood Chain Stock Token could be sold on-chain right now, and at what price against the reference price. Returns the estimated fills at $1,000, $10,000 and $100,000, and the largest size the pools took within 2% and within 5% of the reference price. Give a ticker or an address; a ticker resolves only to the official token, never to a lookalike.

Useful before sizing a sell, a liquidation or an on-chain unwind, and for valuing a Stock Token as collateral or margin. `impact_pct` is the fill against the reference price: negative is below it (`-0.82` means a $10,000 sell was estimated to fill 0.82% below), positive is above it, when the pools trade at a premium to the reference.

Every figure carries the time it was measured and its age in seconds. Readings older than 30 minutes, and max-size searches older than 2 hours, are reported as no reading rather than as a number: a missing figure is unknown, never to be read as zero or as deep. `capped: true` means the search stopped at its ceiling, so the real size is at least that large. These are estimates: each figure is a measurement of a sell quote, not of a fill — not a quote you can take, not a promise of what you could sell now, and not advice. Zorvu does not total liquidity across tokens: a pool pairing two Stock Tokens counts toward both.

inputSchema.description: Give exactly one of symbol or address.

address.description: Contract address of an official Stock Token.

symbol.description: Ticker, for example NVDA. Resolves only to the official Stock Token, never to a lookalike.
